faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ICT Mumbai Senior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Senior Research Fellow position at ICT Mumbai is 22nd August 2026. Ensure you complete the application process before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in Biotechnology or an equivalent qualification to be eligible for the Senior Research Fellow position at ICT Mumbai.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Senior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Senior Research Fellow position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 53,000 per month.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Senior Research Fellow position at the Institute of Chemical Technology Mumbai.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for the ICT Mumbai Senior Research Fellow recruitment must be submitted online.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the Senior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Senior Research Fellow position.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Senior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Senior Research Fellow position will involve an Online/Physical Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Senior Research Fellow position at ICT Mumbai is a contractual role.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the Institute of Chemical Technology Mumbai located?
faq.answer: The Institute of Chemical Technology Mumbai is located in Mumbai, Maharashtra.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply offline for this position?
faq.answer: No, applications for the ICT Mumbai Senior Research Fellow recruitment must be submitted online only. Offline applications will not be accepted.
